annotations.title: Search Historical Federal Contract Awards & CLIN Pricing

description: Query historical federal contract awards, incumbent prime contractors, award ceilings, and labor/CLIN pricing benchmarks filtered by keyword, agency, or 6-digit NAICS code. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive database query (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; all filter parameters are optional and combinable, returning up to `limit` [default 20, max 100] matching historical awards per call). Use this tool when researching past award prices, incumbent vendors, or Price-to-Win (PTW) benchmarks; use `get_live_solicitations` instead to find currently open RFPs available for bidding, or `classify_naics_psc_nigp` if you need to discover the right NAICS code first.

agency.description: Optional issuing federal or state agency name substring filter (e.g., 'Department of Defense', 'Veterans Affairs').

keywords.description: Required technical or domain search keywords matched against award descriptions and CLIN titles (e.g., 'zero trust', 'cloud migration', 'SIEM').

limit.description: Maximum number of award records to return.

naics_code.description: Optional exact 6-digit North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code filter (e.g., '541512' for Computer Systems Design).

name: search_historical_awards

query.description: Echoed query parameter or filter criteria.

results.description: List of standardized award records with line items.

total_count.description: Total number of matching award records found.

title: Search Historical Federal Contract Awards & CLIN Pricing
